about: The dolly (r278, docs/depth-tricks.md §4): a camera zoom that scales each layer by its depth, the near ones more, about the view's middle (ParallaxPageReader.setDolly, PlaxBackground.dolly). Each scene's "zoom" moves straight from its first value at 0 s to its second at 12 s, set before each still. The pages are other rounds' (written by hand, nothing generated). Godot draws each layer in its own view (PlaxBackground._zoom_of, _anchor_of); jME runs core's DollyBatch. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: dolly-in
scenes.about: c01 (Hiver, repeat X, trimmed regions) dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.5: the trees grow to twice their size, the far peaks barely, the sky band not at all; all about the view's middle

scenes.name: dolly-out
scenes.about: c01 dollied out from zoom 1 to 1.6: the near layers shrink most and tile wider, more tiles in the view

scenes.name: zoom-plain
scenes.about: c01 zoomed from 1 to 0.5 without the dolly: the page as one picture, about the view's bottom left corner, as before r278 (Godot's new zoom against core's)

scenes.name: dolly-xy
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded), scrolling up at 30 units/s too, dollied from 0.8 to 0.6: every layer tiles both ways in its own view

scenes.name: dolly-y-mirrored
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored copies to the right), scrolling up at 30 units/s, dollied out from 0.7 to 1.3

scenes.name: dolly-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat, flipX on odd layers): each layer drawn once, scaled about the middle as it scrolls off, from 1 to 0.6

scenes.name: dolly-shaders
scenes.about: s01 (a WAVE ripple and a FOG mist band) dollied from 0.9 to 0.6: the ripple and the noise scale with their layer, the noise laid from where the view at zoom 1 puts the layers

scenes.name: dolly-fog
scenes.about: f01 (a page fog of 0.03, a WAVE and a FOG layer) dollied out from 1 to 1.4: each layer keeps its fog, by its speed, at its own zoom

scenes.name: dolly-hook
scenes.about: e01 (Hiver with an EMPTY slot drawn by a hook) dollied from 1 to 0.6: the hook is handed its layer's tiles, and what it draws is scaled with them

scenes.name: dolly-cross-fade
scenes.about: t01 (Hiver, mirrored, into Calm 4 s in over 4 s) dollied from 0.9 to 0.6: each page's layers by their own page's front

scenes.name: dolly-sequence
scenes.about: q01 (SEQUENCE strips between the hills) dollied from 1 to 0.6: each cycle's slots searched in its own view

scenes.name: dolly-floor
scenes.about: g01 (a MODE7 floor, the trees planted on it) dollied from 1 to 0.7: the floor's rows across its own view, the trees at their stored speed's depth (the floor itself is not dollied row by row: out of r278)
